findings.excerpt: The data-flow diagram sends fixed data and IID randomization into each tree, then aggregates tree predictions.
findings.symptom: The rendered diagram is compressed; node labels overlap around the tree and aggregation labels, making the data-flow labels hard to read.
findings.suggested_repair: Increase horizontal spacing or place the stages on separate rows so all four node labels and incoming/outgoing arrows remain distinct.

findings.excerpt: Three display-math tables are embedded in prose paragraphs, followed immediately by prose introducing the next model.
findings.symptom: The Model B and Model C introductory prose appears to the right of/over the preceding display table; the table/prose sequence is crowded and interleaved in the render.
findings.suggested_repair: Put each table in its own blank-line-separated display-math block and put the next model introduction in a new paragraph.

findings.excerpt: A binary-search tree labels branches by oracle responses and terminal nodes by remaining threshold-index intervals.
findings.symptom: At the rendered diagram scale, the central terminal interval label is crossed/crowded by the incoming branch/edge label and is not cleanly readable.
findings.suggested_repair: Increase sibling spacing or move edge-response labels away from terminal-node boxes so interval labels remain legible.

existing_diagram_checks.mathematical_relations: Fixed data D and independent randomization Theta_b feed each tree T_b; the resulting tree predictions are combined by vote or average. Arrow directions and stated dependencies agree with the source prose.
Two disjoint weighted edges 1--2 (weight 2) and 3--4 (weight 3), with no cross edges, agree with the example matrix and zero-cut partition {1,2},{3,4}.
For query x4, responses 1/0 retain [0,3]/[4,7]; querying x2 and x6 then retains [0,1],[2,3],[4,5],[6,7]. Source branch conventions and labels are consistent.
existing_diagram_checks.visual: Central lower interval label crowded by edge/box at captured scale; reported above.
